parameters.name: AccelerateStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable Global Accelerator. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: ConnectorId
parameters.description: The Connector ID. You can obtain the value by calling [ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The Connector name. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: SwitchStatus
parameters.description:
The instance status of the Connector. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Shutdown.

parameters.name: VipCidr
parameters.description: The CIDR block of the virtual IP address.
